content:
Apple today released watchOS 27.0.1 for Apple Watch. According to Apple, this update fixes an issue where some Apple Watch devices would unexpectedly restart. This update is only available for Apple Watch Series 12 and Apple Watch Ultra 4 users.

The full release notes for watchOS 27.0.1 are as follows:

On Reddit and other forums, some Apple Watch Series 12 and Apple Watch Ultra 4 users have reported that their new watches randomly restart multiple times a day. Although not all users are affected, there is clearly an issue that hopefully today's software update will resolve.

Have you encountered any issues with your Apple Watch Series 12 or Apple Watch Ultra 4? Feel free to let us know in the comments section.
